requirement: add prints a numeric id; ids start at 1 and increase
URL must start with http:// or https://; otherwise error, exit 2, nothing added
list format: id, URL, title, tags (alphabetical, comma-joined), tab-separated
list --tag filters to bookmarks with that tag
search matches title or URL, case-insensitive, ordered by id
delete of an unknown id: error, exit 3
export --format json: array of {id (number), url, title, tags (list)}
Default database bookmarks.db in the current directory; data persists
[intent] Duplicate URL: print existing id, exit 0, no change
[intent] Titles with tabs or line breaks rejected (exit 2)
